messages:
Dana Q.: Quick update: new late-edit exception workflow for payroll-impacting changes and urgent corrections. Manager edits still due Fri 17:00 UTC but if you hit a payroll/comp hold or termination paperwork delay after ingest window, follow this process: 1) open an "HR-AUDIT" ticket, 2) add EXCEPTION=PAYROLL/TERMINATION in the form header, 3) request 'break-glass' small-batch via hrctl. I'll summarize steps below.

Leo M.: Dropping the hrctl commands here for the small-batch path. Use only for PAYROLL/TERMINATION/COMP_HOLD and cc people-ops in the ticket: 

```
# generate a sanitized slice
hrctl export --range "manager:1234" --fields mgr_form --sanitize > slice.csv
# submit small-batch import with ticket ref
hrctl import --small-batch --ticket HR-AUDIT-54321 --file slice.csv --force-override
```

Hiroko S.: Important: small-batch imports require manager sign-off email attached to the ticket (screenshot ok) and an e-signature recorded via the internal e-sign tool. If you don't include that, we won't run the override.

Val C.: For audit: always include a one-line reason in the form comments and put MANAGER_SIG_TS=<iso> and MANAGER_SIG_EMAIL=<email> in the header. Payroll team asked for this to speed reconciliations.

Dana Q.: If the change is time-sensitive (payroll cycle), tag the ticket PRIORITY=payroll and ping me + payroll@redwood. We'll aim to process small-batch within 3 business hours. Non-payroll changes after ingest will be queued for next cycle.

Leo M.: NOTE: do NOT use break-glass for calibration disagreements (rating appeals). Break-glass is strictly for payroll/legal closures: terminated employees, payroll holds, and comp corrections. Appeals still go through calibration & appeals thread.

Hiroko S.: Example header snippet managers can paste into their CSV file: 
```
HEADER: EXCEPTION=PAYROLL; MANAGER_SIG_TS=2025-08-14T16:42:00Z; MANAGER_SIG_EMAIL=alex@example.com; REASON=Finalize termination payroll code 301-B
```

Val C.: If you hit an import error during the small-batch, include the failing rows in the ticket and tag IMPORT_ERROR. That triggers an async rollback and manual review. Don't re-run imports until ops confirms.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Manager edits due Fri 17:00 UTC" posted 2025-08-12 09:00 UTC. Reaction: :alarm_clock:

Dana Q.: Final operational notes: 1) we'll keep a 2-hour "standby" window after ingest for payroll small-batches (staffed by payroll + people-ops), 2) we'll record all override imports in the audit log and attach to employee record, 3) we'll run a reconciliation report 24h after ingest to confirm changes. If you need a prep walk-through for new managers / proxies, sign up for the 20m slots on Thu 14:00 UTC.

Leo M.: Sample ticket template to paste into HR-AUDIT: 
```
Title: Small-batch payroll override for <employee_name> (HR-AUDIT-<ticket>)
Body: brief reason, include manager sign-off screenshot, attach CSV slice, header snippet with EXCEPTION tag, request PRIORITY=payroll if time-sensitive.
```

Hiroko S.: One last heads-up: delegates can submit but the manager must e-sign before we process. If delegate submits without e-sign, ops will triage and request the missing sign-off.

Dana Q.: Thanks all  will post the final checklist tomorrow AM and lock the ingest. :raised_hands: If you see anything ambiguous, ping me directly.
